description: This file defines an 'outlineList' node for a rich text editor, including its rendering, commands, input rules, and node view, specifically for handling outline lists in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: OutlineList
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension for managing outline list blocks with toggle, input rules, and custom node view.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the outline list node, such as HTML attributes and behavior flags.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into this node type.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render this node as HTML.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Adds custom commands, notably toggleOutlineList, with permission checks.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Associates keyboard shortcuts with commands, e.g., toggle outline list.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules for creating outline lists via user input patterns.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom DOM representation for the outline list node.
